access.zh: platform.kimi.com API 与 Kimi 应用；K3 权重同时开放（见本站开放权重侧的 kimi 谱系卡）——API 与开放权重是同一模型的两条使用路径。
access.en: platform.kimi.com API and the Kimi app; K3 weights are also open (see the kimi family card on the open-weight side) — API and open weights are two usage paths to the same model.

generations.zh: 当前代：官方 API 文档 1M token 上下文（max_completion_tokens 默认 131072、最大 1048576）、始终启用思考（Preserved Thinking，推理强度 low/high/max 默认 max）、多模态；平台横幅「Kimi K3 旗舰模型已正式发布」。
generations.en: Current generation: official API docs list a 1M-token context (max_completion_tokens default 131072, max 1048576), always-on thinking (Preserved Thinking; reasoning effort low/high/max, default max), multimodal; the platform banner reads "Kimi K3 flagship officially released".

generations.zh: 上一档：API 文档同页列 kimi-k2.7-code 与 kimi-k2.6 模型对象。
generations.en: Previous step: the same API docs page lists kimi-k2.7-code and kimi-k2.6 model objects.

v.zh: 1M token（官方 API 文档：max_completion_tokens 最大可设 1048576）
v.en: 1M tokens (official API docs: max_completion_tokens can reach 1048576)

v.zh: K3 始终启用思考 + Preserved Thinking；推理强度 low/high/max，默认 max（官方 API 文档）
v.en: K3 always thinks, with Preserved Thinking; reasoning effort low/high/max, default max (official API docs)

v.zh: 多模态理解与 Tool Calling（官方平台文档口径）
v.en: Multimodal understanding and Tool Calling (official platform docs)

positioning.zh: 国产闭源旗舰，但它是本站唯一「API 与开放权重双轨」的家族：K3 权重在 Hugging Face / ModelScope 开放（自定义 Kimi K3 License），API 走 platform.kimi.com。选型时两条路径的许可与数据条款不同，分开读。
positioning.en: The domestic closed flagship — yet the only family here with dual tracks: K3 weights are open on Hugging Face / ModelScope (custom Kimi K3 License) while the API runs on platform.kimi.com. Licences and data terms differ between the two paths — read them separately.

onSite.zh: 开放权重侧本站收录 kimi-k3 系列（谱系卡 + 量化对比）；对话产品轻档案在 AI 工具站。
onSite.en: On the open-weight side this site covers the kimi-k3 series (family card + quantisation); the chat light entry lives on the tools site.
